name: Average channels
summary: Averages the power spectral density over a user-given list of MEG/EEG channels from a PSD table and outputs the averaged spectrum and a plot.
description: Reads the channel-by-frequency PSD TSV, selects the channels in channel_list, averages them into one new channel and plots the mean PSD with its standard deviation band. Use it to summarise the spectrum of a region (for example occipital gradiometers) after computing a PSD. Channel names must match the PSD table exactly.

inputs.description: Power spectral density table (TSV, channels by frequencies).

outputs.description: PSD table containing the averaged channel.
Plot of the averaged PSD with its standard deviation (avg_channels.png).

parameters.description:
List of channels to average. 
Example: 
# Elekta Gradiometers
MEG2042, MEG2043, MEG1913, MEG1912, MEG2113, MEG2112, MEG1922, MEG1923, MEG1942, MEG1943, MEG1642, MEG1643, MEG1933, MEG1932, MEG1733, MEG1732, MEG1723, MEG1722, MEG2143, MEG2142, MEG1742, MEG1743, MEG1712, MEG1713, MEG2032, MEG2033, MEG2313, MEG2312, MEG2342, MEG2343, MEG2322, MEG2323, MEG2433, MEG2432, MEG2122, MEG2123, MEG2333, MEG2332, MEG2513, MEG2512, MEG2523, MEG2522, MEG2133, MEG2132, MEG2542, MEG2543, MEG2532, MEG2533

# Elekta Magnetometers
MEG2041, MEG1911, MEG2111, MEG1921, MEG1941, MEG1641, MEG1931, MEG1731, MEG1721, MEG2141, MEG1741, MEG1711, MEG2031, MEG2311, MEG2341, MEG2321, MEG2431, MEG2121, MEG2331, MEG2511, MEG2521, MEG2131, MEG2541, MEG2531
Name given to the new averaged channel.
